title: Mimamsa Cycle 5 source-library registers (CSV column contracts)
note: CSV registers; each entry fixes column order (enforced by tools/check_c5.py) and controlled values. Identifiers from earlier registers (instr_id, chain_id, change_id, conflict_id, acq_id, record and case ids) are referenced, never overwritten. Enumerated columns are checked on their first token; a parenthesised qualifier may follow (e.g. 'PARTIAL (AMENDMENT_CHAIN_INCOMPLETE)', the brief's label, kept compatible with policy v1).

source_master_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields A (source_id..completeness_status) plus SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY v1 fields (document_authority, carrier_provenance) from docs/legal-audit/schemas/source.schema.json; authentication_status carries CALIBRATION-02 source_authentication_register state when a row exists.

acquisition_register.csv.reuse: D3 ranked acquisition list; existing ACQ ids referenced, never renumbered.

amendment_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields C; carries ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 instrument register and WS-A army_act_amendment_chain columns verbatim (publication_date / commencement_as_printed / effective_date_status kept distinct).

provision_amendment_chain.csv.reuse: Brief chain Publication->Provision->Instrument->Before->After->Effective->Period->Evidence; derived from WS-A provision_change_log (+ supersessions) and ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 provision chronology.

provision_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields B; locator form follows CALIBRATION-02 rule_index_spec/provision_record.schema.json (doc_id#rNN); provision ids reuse WS-D doc ids (rules-army-rules-1954).

source_conflict_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields D; union of SOURCE-CONFLICTS-01, CALIBRATION-02 source_conflicts_c4, WS-B open inconsistencies, ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 official-note discrepancies, plus C5 documentary conflicts.

corpus_crosswalk.csv.reuse: Brief fields E; items parsed from WS-D canonical_coverage.csv; case rows from cases_53.jsonl ids.

source_copy_register.csv.reuse: NEW in c5-2. One row per (source_id, binary sha256). copy_effective_status comes from that sha's own CALIBRATION-02 source-authentication register row through the Cycle 4 shared rule (CALIBRATION-02/tools/evidence_classification.py); it never transfers between copies, however page-equivalent.

legal_adviser_evidence_index.csv.reuse: NEW in c5-2 (C6-05). Pointer index over CALIBRATION-02 adviser questions, the 29 C4 escalations and source conflicts needing legal review; carries states verbatim; determination is always NONE.

migration_c5_1_to_c5_2.source_master_register.csv: added evidence_stage (derived) and verification_limitations after holding_state; holding_state NOT_HELD_NOT_FOUND -> NOT_HELD_NOT_FOUND_IN_SEARCHED_SOURCES, NOT_HELD_LOCATED -> NOT_HELD_CANDIDATE_LOCATED, HELD_PRIMARY_AUTHENTICATION_PENDING -> HELD_AUTHENTICATION_PENDING (applied in 33c2e1b4); new values NOT_HELD_LEAD_ONLY, NOT_HELD_BLOCKED_ACCESS; source_id values unchanged except the BNSS/BSA split (-INDIACODE rows added in 33c2e1b4); added direct_verification_state (structured; explicit input or derived from candidate check methods) and superseded_candidate_ids (candidates excluded from discovery_state, kept for audit) - final-diff review FD-01
migration_c5_1_to_c5_2.corpus_crosswalk.csv: added anchor_copy_id (non-empty only on EXACT_ANCHOR rows); EXACT_ANCHOR eligibility now requires a copy with its own documented provenance instead of a source-level HELD_PRIMARY prefix
migration_c5_1_to_c5_2.acquisition_register.csv: acq_c5_id values are stable identifiers; rank is a separate ordering column (C5-ACQ-23..26 added, ranks renumbered)
migration_c5_1_to_c5_2.compatibility: no downstream consumer outside SOURCE-LIBRARY-C5 reads these registers; earlier-cycle registers are unchanged
migration_c5_1_to_c5_2.legal_adviser_evidence_index.csv: new register (pointer index; no legal content created)
